Hyperlight Optics are unique because of the special nanophotonic materials used in their production, which transform ordinary, diffused light into a new light that is considerably more compatible with our biomolecules. The unique carbon-based ZC60-X nanostructure acts as an ultra-fast photonic resonator. As light passes through the optical layer, Fullerene C60 twists more than 18 billion times per second, helping reorganize and transform incoming light into a more ordered and coherent form. The result is QUANTUMHYPERLIGHT® - light transformed into a more ordered and balanced form, designed to interact more naturally with biological systems and support the body’s physiological balance.

Hyperlight Optics®️ does not simply darken vision. It intelligently transforms light into a more comfortable and biologically supportive visual environment for everyday indoor and outdoor use.
